context:
Goal: MANIFEST works well on the open iPhone Duo, in the Card in Hand design you picked on 2026-10-27 12:25 CDT.
Problem (rule): degen keeps Settings full width, and Ledger is MANIFEST's settings. Spreading Ledger departs from degen, so it needs your word.
Based on (read): README, choice 4: a tab spreads when it has a list and a thing you open from it.
Departs from: degen's full-width Settings — MANIFEST spreads Ledger, with the list left and the opened thing right.

options.gain: One rule for every tab, and no text under the hinge.
options.how: Tally, Orphaned and Ledger each put the list on the left page and the opened thing on the right.
options.label: All three spread
options.lose: Ledger differs from degen's full-width Settings.

options.how: Tally and Orphaned spread. Ledger spans both pages as one list.
options.label: Ledger full width
options.lose: Every Ledger row crosses the fold.

ref: mailaudit #144 (Duo round 2, Card in Hand; branch design/duo-round2, head 441b4e46d); its README, section Choices
title: Duo: do Tally, Orphaned and Ledger spread across both pages?
why: The design lane picks a: one rule, and no row crosses the fold.
